# STUR Physics Lab — AI/LLM information

> STUR: measurement and gravity from the quantum level up. One equation,
> rho_ij(t) = rho_ij(0) <E_j|E_i> exp(i(S_i - S_j)/hbar), with gravity's TEGR action
> (c^4/16 pi G) int e T d^4x in S_i and G = pi a^2 c^3 / (N c_s hbar), c_s = 0.3046
> (vacuum entanglement area law). The Born rule is derived.

## Derivation (DERIVATION.md)
- Born rule from unitarity + locality / non-contextuality (BORN.md).
- Area law, Unruh/modular structure, Jacobson's Clausius step: G from entanglement.
- TEGR: gravity as torsion; Schwarzschild unique; perihelion 42.98"/century, light
  bending 1.7512", gamma = 1, GPS +38.54 us/day.
- Gravity's field follows each branch (COLLECTIVE.md), CONDITIONALLY: the least noise a
  Markovian statistical gravity can carry is the Diosi-Penrose kernel; smeared at the
  entanglement cutoff it would heat matter at ~0.5 W/kg (nucleus-size limited; the old
  1e60 figure assumed point nuclei), 6e10 x the Earth's heat flow. Derived only under
  R0 = a and Markovian dynamics. lambda = 1 is also perturbative quantum gravity's
  prediction, so confirming it would not single this theory out.
- Oppenheim's classical-quantum gravity (OPPENHEIM.md): its decoherence-diffusion
  trade-off, minimised, is the Diosi-Penrose floor; one particle obeys the shape-free
  bound Gamma * S_a >= (M^2/4) I^2.

## Predictions (PREDICTIONS.md)
- Two diamonds entangle through gravity: delta phi = 2.19 rad, 565 runs (design A).
- One 1.5e-14 kg diamond keeps full coherence for 3.24 s; any Markovian statistical
  gravity leaves <= 1.3% (smearing <= 52 um, where Newton's law is tested). If it stays
  coherent, Oppenheim-type gravity must shake it with >= 1.3e-12 m s^-2/rtHz.
- Both diamond tests need ~4e8 x today's largest superposed mass.
- Standalone note (NOTE_331.md): in 3-3-1 models, perturbativity to the Planck scale
  selects N_c = N_g = 3 and the 1/3 quark charges (conditional).
- Visibility loss counts quanta: -ln V = 2 Var(dN) = 2<dN> coth(hbar w / 2 k_B T);
  one trapped ion, contrast 0.787 -> 0.111 from nbar = 0.1 to 5.
